attributes.name: Esobok
attributes.powers:
When you encounter the Esobok, you may discard a card that has the Pharasma trait to automatically defeat it.

Before you act, succeed at Dexterity, Stealth, or Survival 8 check or the difficulty to defeat is increased by 3.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
